## Development Plan

### 1. Recall Tool Enhancement (SMALL ~3-4h)

**Current state**: `src/tool/tools/recall.ts` (175 lines) implements basic session search with:
- Simple substring matching (`includes()` on line 135)
- Density-based relevance scoring (line 37-43)
- Top-20 result slicing (line 154)

**Feature gaps**:
- No typo tolerance (exact substring only)
- No partial results (missing term = session excluded)
- No whole-word boosting (substring matches rank same as whole-word)

**Implementation approach**:
- Add Levenshtein distance-1 typo matching (session titles only, ~30 lines)
- Add whole-word match boosting via regex `\b${term}\b` (~10 lines)
- Add partial-result flag when no session contains all terms (~5 lines)
- Update relevance scoring to weight whole-word > substring matches
- Preserve existing density-based relevance as secondary factor

**Files to modify**:
- `src/tool/tools/recall.ts` — add typo matching, whole-word boosting, partial results
- `tests/tool/tools/recall.test.ts` — add test cases for new features

**Tests to write**:
- Typo matching: query "orchestartor" finds sessions with "orchestrator"
- Whole-word ranking: query "chat" ranks "chat" above "merchant"
- Partial results: query "term1 term2 term3" with only "term1 term2" present returns flagged results

### 2. Agent Turn Retry (SMALL-MEDIUM ~4h)

**Current state**: 
- `src/core/error-backoff.ts` (287 lines) — provider-layer exponential backoff (max 5 retries, 1s initial, 60s cap)
- `src/agent/index.ts` (756 lines) — agent loop with NO turn-level retry
- Transient provider errors (429, 5xx, network blips) abort agent runs

**Feature gap**: Turn-level retry wrapping provider calls in agent loop

**Implementation approach**:
- Wrap provider calls in agent loop with retry envelope (~50 lines)
- Detect retryability: reuse `isRetryableError` from `error-backoff.ts` (~10 lines)
- Never retry when content/tool-calls already emitted (guard on streaming state, ~20 lines)
- Exponential backoff: reuse `ErrorBackoff` class (~10 lines)
- Max 3 turn retries (1s/2s/4s, cap 15s) — distinct from provider-layer retries

**Files to modify**:
- `src/agent/index.ts` — add turn-level retry wrapper around provider calls
- `src/core/error-backoff.ts` — export `isRetryableError` helper if not already exported
- `tests/agent/index.test.ts` — add test cases for turn retry

**Tests to write**:
- Transient error retry: 429 rate limit triggers up to 3 retries with backoff
- Permanent error no-retry: 401 auth error does not retry
- Streaming guard: no retry when content/tool-calls already emitted
- Backoff timing: verify 1s/2s/4s exponential backoff, cap at 15s
